Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline

Class VoidFractionCorrelations

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.VoidFractionCorrelations
public final class VoidFractionCorrelations extends Object
Two-phase void-fraction (gas holdup) correlations.

Provides drift-flux style correlations for the in-situ gas void fraction $\alpha$ (and hence liquid holdup $H_L = 1 - \alpha$) from superficial velocities and fluid properties. These are used by multiphase pipe models such as PipeGray as an alternative holdup closure.

  • Method Details

    • woldesemayatGhajar

      public static double woldesemayatGhajar(double vsg, double vsl, double rhoL, double rhoG, double sigma, double diameter, double inclinationDeg, double pressureBara)
      Woldesemayat and Ghajar (2007) void-fraction correlation.

      A flow-pattern-independent drift-flux correlation valid for horizontal to vertical pipes:

      $$ \alpha = \frac{v_{sg}}{v_{sg}\left[1 + \left(\frac{v_{sl}}{v_{sg}}\right)^{(\rho_g/\rho_l)^{0.1}}\right] + 2.9\left[\frac{gD\sigma(1+\cos\theta)(\rho_l-\rho_g)}{\rho_l^2}\right]^{0.25}(1.22 + 1.22\sin\theta)^{P_{atm}/P}} $$

      Parameters:
      vsg - superficial gas velocity (m/s), positive
      vsl - superficial liquid velocity (m/s), non-negative
      rhoL - liquid density (kg/m3)
      rhoG - gas density (kg/m3)
      sigma - gas-liquid interfacial tension (N/m)
      diameter - pipe inner diameter (m)
      inclinationDeg - pipe inclination from horizontal (degrees; 90 for a vertical well)
      pressureBara - system pressure (bara)
      Returns:
      gas void fraction $\alpha$ in the range (0, 1)
